items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: They were easy guys. Maybe they were easy because I don’t know if any of them had any talent except maybe David, the lead singer

ctx.x: Interesting. Not that much different from those early demos you did.
Right. Right. They were easy guys. Maybe they were easy because I don’t know if any of them had any talent except maybe David, the lead singer — I can’t remember his name.
